## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), the Step-3 read: **electron side carries the fan**

**Run 6, electron, n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0 (F_L = 33.1 T), B 0→10 T.** Clean, ABAB-shaped tone set:

- **7.1 T** — dominant light tone, alive down to the 0.3 T record edge (**onset censored ≤ 0.3 T**; SNR 40 at the edge).
- **22.1 T** — heavy-tone candidate. Flagged `~3×7.1` by the tracker, but 3×7.1 = 21.3 vs 22.1 is ~2.6·δF (δF = 0.31 T) off an exact harmonic, and discarding it as one leaves 7.1 T alone against F_L = 33.1 — breaks the Luttinger sum badly (the investigation's harmonic-screen caution). Kept as the heavy pocket; the fan's n-dependence decides (a harmonic tracks 3.00·f_light exactly; the model heavy/light ratio sweeps 4.8→3.5 over n = 2.0→3.2×10¹²).
- **14.1 T** = 2×7.1 exactly — harmonic. **29.5 T** ≈ 7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 — breakdown **sum-tone candidate** (symmetry-allowed in ABAB), sitting at 0.89·F_L.
- Pair sum 7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 = **0.88·F_L** — a single global scale inside the lever-arm prior (0.8–1.2). Partition 0.24/0.76 vs model ABAB 0.22/0.78 at this n. **No tone at F_L = 33.1** → ABCA singleton disfavored on this side. Sub-4 T low-f peaks wander with detrender/cutoff (stability sweep, `hera_scratch/ana_spots.py`) — background residue, not claimed.

**Run 7, hole, n = −1.2×10¹², D = 0 (F_L = 12.4 T), B 10→0.3 T.** The recipe's stated near-CNP exception regime (model ABAB pair 5.9/6.5 T — close and balanced, beat-like): dominant ~6.6 T with a comb of mutually-inconsistent partners (4.7, 8.5, 9.4, 12.3), and the stability sweep wanders (top-3 peaks move ~1 T across reasonable cutoffs). Uninformative for the count at this density by design; **the hole side within our gate limits (|n| ≤ 1.27×10¹²) cannot leave the exception regime** — that is a coverage fact for the hedges, not a re-measure trigger.

**Take:** electron side is the fan side. Provisional lean ABAB (light 7.1 + heavy 22.1, sum 0.88·F_L, sum-tone at f₁+f₂) — **not a verdict**; the fan must show both branches tracking the ABAB F(n) curves (vs the trilayer ML+BL curves — adjacent-N dual overlay), the partition holding across n, and the 22.1 T tone diverging from 3·f_light. Handoff to the fan: onset ≤ 0.3 T (censored), Δ(1/B) = 1/(3·F_L(n_max)) ≈ 0.0101 T⁻¹, sr1 50 µV / τ = 0.3 s inherited.

"""sdh-spot-check read — run 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12, D = 0) and run 7 (hole, n = -1.2e12, D = 0).
Raw first, then the detrended 1/B record and the FFT read against F_L and the
tetralayer forward model (hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0.py).
Onset/tone tracking via hera.analysis.sdh_onset; FFT via sdh_fft (bg poly in B, FFT in 1/B).
"""
import sys
if "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count" not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
import fs_count_b0 as fs
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency

R_FS = 50e-6 / 10e-9          # sr1 sensitivity / I_bias = 5 kOhm full scale (both runs)
SPOTS = {6: +3.2e16, 7: -1.2e16}  # m^-2, from the run-5 calibration

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 8))
for row, (rid, nspot) in enumerate(SPOTS.items()):
    run = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    mc = run.meta["measurement_config"]
    B = run.col("magnet_field")
    I = run.col("sr0_X") / float(mc["sr0_gain"])         # measured drain current
    R = (run.col("sr1_X") / float(mc.get("sr1_gain", 1))) / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]

    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(nspot))
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=R_FS)
    print(f"===== run {rid}  n = {nspot/1e16:+.2f}e12 cm^-2  F_L = {FL:.1f} T =====")
    print(on.summary())
    bmax = on.clip_high_b if on.clip_high_b else B.max()
    dF = 1.0 / (1.0 / on.onset_b - 1.0 / bmax)
    print(f"onset_b = {on.onset_b:.3f} T ({'censored at record edge' if any(t.censored for t in on.tones) else 'measured'}), "
          f"deltaF = {dF:.2f} T over [{on.onset_b:.2f}, {bmax:.1f}] T")

    # model tones at this density
    _, ab = fs.abab_fs(nspot); ms = fs.abab_mstar(nspot)
    _, topo, _, _, Fa = fs.abca_fs(nspot)
    print("model ABAB:", ", ".join(f"{F:.1f} T (m* {m:.3f})" for (F, _), (_, m) in zip(ab, ms)),
          f"| ABCA singleton: {Fa:.1f} T ({topo})")

    f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.2 * on.onset_b, bmax), bg_degree=5, log=False)
    sp = spec[0]

    ax = axes[row]
    ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=0.5)
    ax[0].set(xlabel="B [T]", ylabel="Rxx [Ohm]", title=f"run {rid} raw  n = {nspot/1e16:+.1f}e12")
    sel = (B >= on.onset_b) & (B <= bmax)
    dR = R[sel] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[sel], R[sel], 5), B[sel])
    ax[1].plot(1 / B[sel], dR, lw=0.6)
    ax[1].set(xlabel="1/B [1/T]", ylabel="dRxx [Ohm]", title=f"detrended, B > {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    ax[2].plot(f, sp, lw=0.8)
    ax[2].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    for (F, _) in ab:
        ax[2].axvline(F, color="tab:red", ls=":", alpha=0.8)
    ax[2].axvline(Fa, color="tab:green", ls="-.", alpha=0.6)
    zoom = (f > 2) & (f < 1.4 * FL)
    ax[2].set(xlim=(0, 1.4 * FL), ylim=(0, 1.2 * sp[zoom].max()),
              xlabel="F [T]", ylabel="|FFT|", title="FFT in 1/B (red ABAB, green ABCA)")
    ax[2].legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0, n = +1.8 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.4 → 6 T

> **05:30** · LF electron D=0 stacking fan: n +1.8..+3.2e12 (81 pts), B 0.4->6 T uniform-1/B (233 rows, d(1/B)=0.01006), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6 tau), ends at 6 T · **ETA ~17:00** (≈11h30m)

The stacking-call fan (investigation Step 4), designed from the runs-6/7 spot-check read (ana): electron side is the clean side — light tone 7.1 T + heavy candidate 22.1 T summing to 0.88·F_L, sum-tone at 29.5 T; hole side is the near-CNP exception regime and can't leave it within our gate limits. The fan's job: both branches on the ABAB-vs-trilayer dual F(n) overlay, the Luttinger partition across density, and 22.1 T diverging from 3·f_light (harmonic screen) — model heavy/light ratio sweeps 4.8 → 3.5 across this window while a harmonic stays at 3.00.

**Design (all floors computed, `landau-fan.md` step 1):** n-window +1.8 → +3.2×10¹² (templates separate ≳ 2×10¹²; low edge catches the partner-fraction/trilayer crossing; n_max = TG-limit edge, V_tg ≤ +0.984 V). **B_lo = 0.4 T is claim-floored, not onset-floored** — the run-6 onset is *censored* ≤ 0.3 T, so B_lo isn't onset-limited; 0.4 T is the cheapest edge that clears the partner floor at n_lo (f_light(1.8e12) ≈ 2.6 T at scale 0.88 → 6.0 periods ≥ 5; δF = 0.43 T, heavy-vs-F_L separation 2.6 T ≥ 2δF). **Coverage trade, stated:** rows 0.3–0.4 T are excluded — including them costs +83 rows ≈ +3.5 h and buys δF 0.43 → 0.32 T and 8 vs 6 partner periods, surplus to the claim. B_hi = 6 T (heavy-tone record 70 periods at n_max; δF is 1/B_lo-dominated, 10 T would improve it < 3%; run 6 already holds a 10 T record at n_max for the B-window-split check). Grid: 233 rows uniform in 1/B, Δ(1/B) = 0.01006 = Nyquist/3 on F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T (the fastest credible tone, sum-tone included) × 81 n-points (2.2 per ray period at 0.4 T). Sensitivity 50 µV = 5 kΩ FS, inherited from the spot checks: worst corner (n_min × B_max) anchored at run-6 R_max 530 Ω × ≤2× low-n factor ≈ ≤1.1 kΩ → ≥4.7× headroom to the 5.45 kΩ soft-clip. fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — per-column-FFT dwell, base step 7).

**Price (session-calibrated):** per-point 1.9 s (run 5: 4873 s / 4158 pts at fast_delay 1.0 → read ≈ 0.10 s async) → grid 18,873 pts ≈ 10.0 h + traverse 5.6 T ≈ 41 min + 233 × (3 s settle + retrace 0.5 s + slow_delay 1 s) ≈ 17 min ≈ **11 h; realistic 11.5–12.5 h** (session evidence: actuals run 5–10% over). Magnet starts at 0 (operator readback), ascends, **ends at 6 T** — the LK mass split (temperature-dependence Flavor B) then rides it down, no re-traverse. Gates park at 0 V on completion.

**Checkpoints (E1, hera-watch armed on data/8):** first rows ~30 min in (signal on both channels, fs fraction, leakage, B tracking, row rate vs price — abort criterion: any row fs ≥ 0.9 on sr1, sustained gate current > guard, or rate > 30% over price); then interim per-column FFT at B ≈ 1 T (~row 150, ≈ 6.5 h — light-tone branch already has ≥ 10 periods at n_max: continue/abandon call on whether f_light(n) tracks any model curve) and at ~9 h. In-cell leak guard trips the sweep at |I_gate| > 1 nA.

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): n = +1.8 -> +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.4 -> 6 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(1.8, 3.2, 81)              # 1e12 cm^-2, ascending; 2.2 pts per ray period at 0.4 T
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)                      # D = 0 line
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"fast axis: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 (81 pts), Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")

B_vec = field_invB(0.4, 6.0, 233)           # uniform 1/B, d(1/B) = 0.01006 = Nyquist/3 on F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"slow axis: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows (dB {abs(B_vec[1]-B_vec[0])*1e3:.1f} mT "
      f"-> {abs(B_vec[-1]-B_vec[-2])*1e3:.0f} mT); est. 11 h (grid 10.0 h + traverse 41 min + row overhead 17 min)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.4), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), gates ({k_tg.volt():+.3f}, {k_bg.volt():+.3f}) V, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, "
      f"output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
_tau = sr1.time_constant()
print(f"sr1 tau {_tau} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; fast_delay 1.8 s = 6 tau")
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-3, "fan dwell keyed on tau = 0.3 s; re-derive fast_delay if tau changed"

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (spot-check inheritance): 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA.
# Worst corner (n_min x B_max) anchored at run-6 R_max 530 Ohm x <=2 low-n factor -> >=4.7x headroom to soft-clip.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan-vti electron side: n = +1.80..+3.20e12 (81), D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  "B 0.4 -> 6 T uniform-1/B (233), sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron-side D = 0 stacking fan: n = +1.80 to +3.20e12 cm^-2 (81 pts), '
              f'B = 0.4 to 6.0 T uniform-1/B (233 rows, d(1/B) = 0.01006 /T = Nyq/3 on F_L = 33.1 T); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, '
              f'D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; follows spot checks runs 6/7 (light 7.1 + heavy 22.1 T)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=1, fast_delay=1.8)
finally:
    # park gates; field stays at 6 T (the LK ladder rides it down — no re-traverse)
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end state: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates ({k_tg.volt():+.3f}, {k_bg.volt():+.3f}) V")
